parameters.content:
## Create and publish Shopify product videos

### How it works
Select eligible Shopify products, render branded vertical videos in a batch, and return them for review. When publishing is enabled, stage the files in Shopify, attach them to matching products and tag accepted results.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Set the canonical shopDomain, branding and maxProducts in Config. Keep publishToShopify=false while reviewing videos.
4. Create Header Auth named X-Shopify-Access-Token with an installed Shopify Admin token and assign it to the Shopify requests. The app needs read_products, write_products and write_files; refresh expiring tokens before scheduled runs.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Set it to **true** for an editor draft and quote.
6. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Detailed setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/shopify-catalog-videos.md).

nodes.name: 1. Choose settings and an entry point

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Load eligible Shopify products

Require an active product with a title, public photo and priced variant. Skip already processed products and usable existing videos.

## 3. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 4. Choose an optional editor preview

dryRun=true returns an editor draft and credit quote. The default false branch renders and spends Zvid credits; upstream AI services may charge separately.

## 5. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

## 6. Review or begin publishing

publishToShopify=false returns videos for review. Enabling it changes product media in Shopify.

## 7. Check each video before upload

Read each completed file’s size and create a Shopify staged-upload target. Shopify media transfer requires HTTP Request nodes.

## 8. Transfer videos to Shopify

Download each MP4, upload it to the staged target, and check that the transfer succeeded before attaching it.

## 9. Attach and tag accepted products

Associate staged videos with their matching product IDs. Tag accepted products only; Shopify processes the media asynchronously, so confirm READY in Shopify Admin.

## 10. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download.
